summary: Diff adds a single-page PropertyOps® homepage with section orchestration, a modal consultation request form with client-side validation, backend storage/query endpoints for consultation requests, global styling/theme tokens, and basic SEO in index.html. However, several requirements are either not evidenced in the diff (due to truncation) or not implemented (notably timestamps and generated icon assets usage). Diff also introduces unrequested admin/access-control and user profile functionality and appears to touch immutable hook files.

missing_requirements.reason: The TechnologySystemsSection content is truncated; the required exact headline text is not visible in the provided diff summary, so implementation cannot be confirmed.

missing_requirements.requirement: How It Works section presents exactly three steps with the provided titles and supporting text.
missing_requirements.reason: Although three steps are present, the BuildRequest requires the provided (exact) titles and supporting text; the diff shows different step titles/text but does not prove they match the provided copy direction.

missing_requirements.requirement: Services section contains exactly these three services (no more, no less): Rental Turnover Condition Reports; Minor Turnover Repairs & Punch Lists; Exterior Maintenance Packages.
missing_requirements.reason: The ServicesSection implementation is not shown (section file is truncated), so the exact set/count of services cannot be verified from the diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend persists submitted consultation requests with timestamp and unique ID.
missing_requirements.reason: Backend stores an incrementing Nat id but no timestamp field is present in ConsultationRequest or captured during submit.

missing_requirements.reason: How It Works uses lucide-react icons (not the required generated PNG icons). Other sections are truncated, and no references to the required generated icon filenames are shown.
